description: macOS 12 to 15 client SYN over Ethernet or Wi-Fi (MSS 1460)

provenance.notes: SYN: p0f lists 65535, mss,nop,ws,nop,nop,ts,sok,eol+1, TTL 64, DF for Mac OS X (confirmed layout). p0f's window scale for 10.9+ is 4 (1 and 3 for older); 6 here is not confirmed for current macOS and is the least certain value. IP ID 0: XNU ip_output.c sets ip_id = 0 for atomic (DF) packets when rfc6864=1, the default; p0f's id+ for macOS is older. Retransmits: XNU tcp_syn_backoff {1,1,1,1,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,64,64} times a base RTO assumed to be 1 s (base not confirmed). Timestamps: XNU tsval = t_ts_offset + tcp_now (random per-connection offset by default, 1 ms ticks), the same as Linux, so no rewriting. Whether the SYN carries ECE+CWR is unconfirmed. Re-capture on our own Macs with `lb-fptest tcp-capture --flow` and set status to captured.
